messages:
jack-support: FYI ticket #6248 — customer reports requests that should hit their EU model are landing in us-west and failing auth. https://tix/reports/6248 :confused:
sasha-cs: Customer says it started after a mobile release yesterday. They send region in the JSON body (region: "eu") and in some cases the router picks us-west. They attached a few failing request IDs.
emma-eng: Can you paste a raw request/headers from one of the failures? want to check precedence (header vs body vs query).
jack-support: Pasting minimal repro (sanitized):
```
POST /v1/generate HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.dev
Authorization: Bearer sk_live_[redacted]
Content-Type: application/json
x-client-id: mobile-android-23
x-region: 0

{ "model": "gpt-4-mini", "region": "eu", "input": "hello" }
```
jack-support: Router log for that request: `route=choose_edge user_id=acct_987 edge=us-west reason=header_x_region=0`
emma-eng: :thinking_face: Interesting — header x-region is present and contains the literal "0" string. Router treats any non-empty header as authoritative, so it picks header over body param.
emma-eng: Repro notes: I could reproduce locally — if x-region == "0" we route to nearest-pop (us-west) instead of honoring JSON body.
jack-support: Customer says their mobile SDK sets region header to 0 when unset as a placeholder. They assumed body.region would be used as a fallback.
kyle-devex: Which SDK version? We recently changed header serialization in android sdk 3.2.1 to avoid nulls by writing "0".
sasha-cs: Confirmed: customer on android 3.2.1.
emma-eng: Root cause: placeholder value "0" is truthy for the router header precedence rule. So invalid placeholder silently overrides correct body.region. Also causes auth scope mismatch because token is scoped to EU org — router picks us-west and the token doesn't map, resulting in 401s for the customer.
emma-eng: Short-term mitigation: treat header values of "0", "none", "-" and empty-string as absent. I'll open a quick router patch to normalize these before precedence.
jack-support: Can we also add a 4xx to let callers know header is malformed instead of silently rerouting? Customer would prefer explicit failure over silent misroute.
emma-eng: Good idea. Plan: 1) Router normalization that treats known placeholders as absent (patch) 2) Add optional validation header flag behind feature flag to return 400 for malformed region header 3) SDK patch to stop emitting "0" (kyle to coordinate) 4) Canary rollout 5% for 2h then 25% then global if metrics are clean.
kyle-devex: I'll cut android sdk 3.2.2 that omits placeholder header when region unset. Also add a debug env var so mobile teams can opt into stricter header validation.
infra-bot: [alert] router-edges: routing-anomaly spike detected — 174 events in past 10m (avg 12m). Investigating.
jack-support: Sasha — can you give customer ETA and offer a temporary workaround? maybe ask them to remove header on client side for now.
sasha-cs: Told customer we have a fix in progress and a recommended workaround: strip x-region header or upgrade to SDK 3.2.2 when available. They asked if we can force-correct their in-flight requests — they are losing revenue.
emma-eng: We can push the normalization patch as a quick server-side hotfix (no SDK required) — will rate-limit and canary. I'll target rollout in next 90 minutes.
kyle-devex: Will coordinate SDK release notes calling out the placeholder bug and recommending header omission when unset.
jack-support: Thanks team. I'll update ticket and post a short blurb to the customer once canary starts. :thumbsup:
emma-eng: After the rollout we should also add a router metric for "placeholder-header-detected" so we can alert on this pattern in future.
sasha-cs: Customer appreciated the quick response. They asked for an email when canary reaches 25%.
jack-support: Noted — will follow up.
emma-eng: Patch deployed to canary (5%) — watch logs for normalized routing and any 4xx from validation if turned on.
infra-bot: [deploy] router-normalize-header v1.0.1 -> canary (5%) by emma-eng
jack-support: Customer updated: initial failures stopped for some requests after canary. Monitoring continues.
emma-eng: Will roll to 25% in 2h if no regressions.
kyle-devex: SDK 3.2.2 build uploaded to staging, QA green. I'll post release later today.
jack-support: Closing loop in ticket and adding action items (sdk patch, router metric, validation flag).
